author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Every workshop visit results in a tool wishlist for Adam Savage, and this one is no different! At @NationalParkService's Museum Conservation Lab, wooden artifacts conservator Curtis Sullivan takes us through some of his metering and measuring instruments, and explains how he uses them during his on-site inspections (which take place in extremely varied environments if you think about the U.S. national parks system). Any of these tools surprise you?
